text: Remove any remaining placenta and clean the uterus with water. The main task is repositioning the prolapsed uterus — it is heavy, so carry it on a tray supported by two people and push it back in gradually, centimeter by centimeter, until fully reduced; this becomes much harder if the cow is lying down and won't stand, and can become nearly impossible if the cow is agitated and still contracting strongly. Close the vulva with a strong suture for 3 days, and inject tetracycline for 3 days.
